title: Structural products maker Renny Strips files DRHP for IPO; seeks Rs 300 crore via fresh equity sale
description: Structural products manufacturer Renny Strips has taken the first formal step toward the capital markets, filing its draft red herring prospectus with the capital markets Sebi India for an IPO. The Ludhiana-based company plans to raise up to Rs 300 crore through a fresh issue of equity shares, along with an offer for sale of up to 1.2 crore shares by existing shareholders.

title: Renny Strips Ltd IPO Details
description: Funding the capital expenditure requirements of the Company. Prepayment or re-payment, in full or in part, of certain outstanding borrowings availed by its Company. General corporate purposes.

title: Renny Strips files DRHP to launch its IPO with Sebi, check details
description: Renny Strips files DRHP for IPO with Rs 300 crore fresh issue and 12 million shares OFS; Pantomath Capital Advisors is sole lead manager. Book building, BSE/NSE listing planned.

title: Main Board IPO Filed with SEBI
description: Renny Strips Limited, a leading structural steel company in India, has officially filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with SEBI for a Main Board IPO, seeking to raise up to ₹300 crore via fresh equity issue.

title: Renny Strips Limited, manufacturer of structural steel products has officially filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) for a Main Board IPO.
description: Company operates a vertically integrated, sustainability-focused structural products business manufacturing MS billets, wire rods, HR coils, ERW pipes and tubes, and engineered scaffolding and formwork systems. Our energy-efficient cascading production model reduces costs and enhances quality, supported by automation and digital quality monitoring.
